comments.author: @Cre-Art
comments.text: When I was a teen I stayed at the beautiful Castle Harbour Hotel. Six weeks in paradise with a group of (supervised) teens. The staff was amazing, and the people so friendly. Even had a nice boyfriend there. It was such a loss when the hotel was bought by a corporation and ultimately destroyed. Oh, and one special moment was dancing on stage with Ben E. King at the Hotel Inverurie. I was very fortunate to have had this experience.

replies.author: @Cre-Art
replies.text:
@trueglobe66 The hotel was made of stone and built on several levels. It felt like being in a castle. The doorman used to entertain us with sleight-of-hand magic tricks. We had tea at four every afternoon. Another memory popped up. I had just come back to my room, turned on the radio and froze. It was Stevie Wonder's brand new release, "Fingertips."

We also used to go into Hamilton to shop and eat. There was a beautiful garden there. In fact, all of Bermuda was beautiful. I never got to return, but it sure made an impression.
